subject: RM_StranglerVenomvine
departures: canes thin as cord, no thicker than a wrist at any point: no thick woody trunk or swollen base
canes very long and rope-like, running unbroken from end to end
canes laid round their support in tight, closely packed turns like coiled rope, not loosely draped or trailing
grips by winding and tightening around the support: no tendrils, aerial roots or sucker pads
the support it binds shows strain where the coils bite, such as cracked mortar or a constricted, failing trunk
